name: Olive
source:
Number one hater of your boyfriend. As someone who thinks people should shower before going on a date, let's just say she has a less than stellar view of your boyfriend.

You've agreed to disagree on the matter but still, she has a bad feeling about him. When certain... things happen, you have to wonder. Maybe she's been right all along?

[From [url=https://whatdoinamemyself.itch.io/shrouded-in-your-love]itch.io[/url]]
